trust_boundaries.name: Purdue OT Testbed Network
trust_boundaries.description: Virtualized Purdue Model environment containing traffic generation, pfSense, Suricata, OpenPLC, and Conpot. Implementation of microsegmentation and hardening requires evidence validation.

trust_boundaries.name: Analysis and Evidence Zone
trust_boundaries.description: Telemetry ingestion, parsing, normalized data, triage, ML evaluation, and reports. Requires authenticated transfer, sandboxing, least privilege, integrity, provenance, and retention.

trust_boundaries.name: Enterprise / Developer Zone
trust_boundaries.description: Source repository, developers, dependency manifests, security policy, and administrative access.

trust_boundaries.name: OT Network Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary separating the isolated OT testbed from enterprise/developer access.

trust_boundaries.name: Analysis Evidence Boundary
trust_boundaries.description: Boundary protecting telemetry, parser execution, analysis processes, ML assets, and reports.
